routes.label: TiO2_pristine
routes.method: nonhydrolytic sol-gel (TiCl4 in ethanol / benzyl alcohol, 85 °C), TIPD-stabilised colloid in ethanol
routes.quote: The pristine TiO2 nanocrystals were synthesized by using a modified nonhydrolytic sol–gel method with all procedures done in the ambient condition.

reagents.name: titanium tetrachloride
reagents.quote: First, 0.5 mL TiCl4 was injected drop by drop into 2 mL cold anhydrous ethanol with strong stirring.

reagents.name: anhydrous ethanol (reaction solvent)
reagents.quote: First, 0.5 mL TiCl4 was injected drop by drop into 2 mL cold anhydrous ethanol with strong stirring.

reagents.name: anhydrous benzyl alcohol
reagents.supplier_quote: Dimethylformamide (DMF), benzyl alcohol, chlorobenzene, and dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) were purchased from Sigma‐Aldrich.
reagents.quote: After the solution cooled down to room temperature, 10 mL of anhydrous benzyl alcohol was added to the previous solution and stirred for 10 min.

reagents.name: diethyl ether (precipitation)
reagents.quote: The product of TiO2 nanocrystals was then precipitated from the as‐obtained solution by the addition of diethyl ether and isolated by centrifugation at 5000 rpm for 2 min.

reagents.name: anhydrous ethanol (washing)
reagents.quote: The solid was subsequently washed by adding anhydrous ethanol and diethyl ether, followed by a similar centrifugation step (5000 rpm for 2 min) for three times.
